messages:
arun: FYI folks — postmortem for INC-4321 is up: https://redwood.example.com/postmortems/INC-4321. Need quick alignment on customer-facing follow-ups: status copy, short external timeline, who owns sending summaries to customers, and rules for full RCA sharing. Can we decide owners and timelines today?

lina: I can take status page copy. Will draft a 2-line blurb + 1-sentence impact. Planning to push to the status page within 2 hours once we lock wording. :+1:

sam: i'll own customer summaries for enterprise customers (CustOps handoff). ETA to have templated 1-paragraph summaries: EOD today. For the detailed list of affected customers i'll need input from support.

support-bot: @support-team I created ticket SUP-1156 to compile the impacted-customer list for INC-4321. Please update by EOD.

maria: Legal note: for regulated customers we need a 72-hour review window before sending anything that discusses root cause specifics or internal mitigations. Summaries that only state timeline + customer impact are fine immediately. I'll review any draft that mentions mitigation details.

jess: quick technical note — root cause looks like the retry/backoff regression we saw in Jan. If we share the root cause to customers, let's also include the mitigation steps and our plan to detect recurrence automatically. Otherwise customers will ask about recurrence.

arun: good call. So proposed split: (1) status page short blurb + link to PM (public) within 2 hours (owner: lina), (2) short external incident summary for impacted customers (owner: sam/support) within EOD, (3) full RCA restricted to customers with NDA/regulatory needs after legal review (owner: maria) within 72h, (4) remediation owner and timeline tracked in PM and Action Tracker (owner: jess to own remediation delivery plan). Agree?

lina: agreed. Draft status copy below — feel free to suggest edits:```We experienced degraded API availability for ~45 minutes on 2026-03-23 UTC due to a service retry/backoff regression. Impacted requests may have seen increased latency and transient errors. We’ve implemented a mitigation and are deploying a permanent fix. Full postmortem: https://redwood.example.com/postmortems/INC-4321```

sam: looks good. For the customer summary template i'll use:
- outage window
- observable impact
- short root cause line (non-sensitive)
- actions taken now + ETA for permanent fix
- contact for follow-up (support rep)

maria: add: "If you are a regulated customer and need a detailed technical report, reply to this message and we'll coordinate a reviewed copy." Keeps the public summary light but opens the door.

jess: i'll own the remediation plan: linking action items in the postmortem to JIRA PM-789. Action items: 1) revert regression + hardened tests (owner: jess, ETA 48h), 2) rollout canary + monitoring alerts for the retry metric (owner: sam, ETA 72h), 3) add regression test to CI (owner: eng-qa, ETA 7 days). I'll update the Action Tracker and ping here when each moves.

arun: can we also add a recurring-incident note in the PM so GTM/sales can triage questions? Some customers called back about recurrence concern.

lina: yes will add a "recurrence risk" bullet and suggested customer language for sales.

ops-bot: Deploy job #depl-982 queued -> started. Logs: tail -n 50 /var/log/deploys/depl-982.log

sam: when ops-bot confirms production rollback or fix, i'll send the customer summary. Otherwise i'll hold to avoid confusion.

jess: rollback in progress, will report status in 15.

arun: thanks all — please update SUP-1156 and PM-789 with owners/timestamps. We'll reconvene in #incidents if anything blocks. :eyes:
